_comment: Voiceover for wen-launch.mp4. `start` is seconds into the video; the merge script places each clip at exactly that time, so clips need only start cleanly on the first word — no trimming to length. `budget` is the gap before the next line begins, measured off the visual beats; every line was checked against a 175wpm read with headroom. Edit here, not in script.md: scripts/merge-audio.js reads this file.

lines.note: Deliberate, a little dry. Lands in unison with the line typing on screen.
Flat challenge, no lift at the end. This is the whole pitch. Take the pause before it.

lines.text: Every round is a real slice of Ethereum history.
lines.note: Tempo picks up here. Plays over the board arriving.

lines.text: The riddle is your only clue to when.
lines.note: The riddle has finished typing by now — let the viewer read it under this.

lines.text: You're never told when this is.
lines.note: In unison with the title. Slow down; this is the thesis.

lines.text: Now bet on where it goes next.
Pick the cells it has to pass through. Further out pays more.
lines.note: Over the eight picks landing one by one.
Just before the white path starts walking.

lines.text: Not a simulation. Every candle is a real Uniswap swap.
May 2022. People called the bottom here too.
lines.note: Read the year as 'May twenty twenty-two'. Beat of silence before it — this is the payoff.

lines.text: And every one of them, proven on Creditcoin.
lines.note: Don't rush it. The number is already on screen at full size, so this line only has to name where the proof lives.

lines.text: wen. Bet on what already happened. wenctc dot fun.
lines.note: 'wen' as a word, not W-E-N. Domain spoken as 'wen C T C dot fun'.
